notes: Copper (Grey SFP) electrical transceiver over CAT5 UTP or better; typical reach 100 m. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C stated in technical data table cell alongside operating 0°C to +70°C and power < 1.05 W. SGMII physical layer at 1.25 Gb/s, 8B10B encoded at all times regardless of negotiated rate. Rx_LOS pin for link indication. Auto-negotiation on SGMII. Preferred master (master mode uses local clock). 10/100/1000 BASE-T requires SGMII with no clocks in host; 1000BASE-T when host uses SERDES interface. RoHS-6/6 compliant. 2-wire serial interface per SFF-8472.
suggestions: Clarify whether reach_km should use 0.1 for 100 m copper. Add schema support for copper media (CAT5 UTP) and electrical host/media interfaces (RJ45, SGMII) distinct from optical MSA media codes.
